We evaluate PlugD on a fact verification dataset, FEVER, four question answering datasets, including Natural Questions (NQ), HotpotQA, TriviaQA, ELI5, a dialogue generation dataset, Wizard of Wikipedia (WoW), and two slot filling datasets, Zero Shot RE (zsRE)...
outputs: Generated dialogue responses and abstractive answers
The model generates answers for question answering, verifies facts, generates dialogue responses, and fills slots based on document knowledge.

quote: Metrics. Following previous work, we adopt ... ROUGE-L (RL) for the long abstractive question answering tasks (ELI5); F1 score for the dialogue generation task (WoW).

...We adopt accuracy for the fact verification task (FEVER) and slot filling tasks, exact match (EM) and F1 score for the extractive question answering tasks, and ROUGE-L (RL) for the long abstractive question answering tasks (ELI5)...

Following previous work, we adopt accuracy for the fact verification task (FEVER) and slot filling tasks (zsRE, T-REx); exact match (EM) and F1 score for the extractive question answering tasks (NQ, HotpotQA, TriviaQA); ROUGE-L (RL) for the long abstractive question answering tasks (ELI5); F1 score for the dialogue generation task (WoW).
